about:
Mark One Metal Works is a custom metal fabrication and design shop based in Sparks, Nevada. The company was founded in 1996 by Mark, who began his career as a transmission mechanic under his father John. After managing a fabrication department at a Peterbilt dealership in Reno, he launched Levco Transmission in 1991, later selling it to pursue off-road racing and a role managing production for Torchmate, a CNC plasma cutting manufacturer. He established Mark One Metal Works to offer a broad range of fabrication skills.

The shop provides machining, welding, tube bending, CNC plasma cutting, and CAD design services, working primarily in aluminum. It handles projects from one-off prototypes to production runs, producing items such as gates, fences, railings, stairs, desks, tables, doors, fixtures, furniture, hot rod components, off-road vehicle parts, custom signs, and trophies. Equipment includes a Lincoln Electric plasma cutting table. No facility size or headcount is disclosed.

Mark One serves commercial, residential, and industrial clients in the Reno–Sparks area and beyond. Examples include custom railings and stairs for homes, aluminum fabrication for industrial projects, roll cages and lightweight parts for off-road vehicles, and trophies for competitions.

The company emphasizes exceptional design, unmatched quality, great customer service, and unique metalworking concepts, drawing on over 30 years of experience in fabrication, machining, and racing.
